recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; it applies the published clarification to the current build inputs while avoiding unrelated Task-resource terminology changes.
issue_request: FHIR-11429 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core workflow issue asking section 12.1.2.9 to replace 'PUT Claim Task' with 'PUT Pick Task' to describe selecting work from a queue and avoid confusion with the Claim resource.
initial_application: Jira records application in svn @10162, represented in git by 83f1205cc1f012816734622c56ee12d93a24212d. Later workflow refactoring in 50f4d4fa63 split the workflow content into current pages and diagram assets, but the current workflow-management source still retained stale 'claim' wording and Option F/H diagrams still contained 'PUT Claim Task'.
additional_context: source/workflow-management.html is active through source/hierarchy.xml and publish.ini, and the Option F/H PNGs are both referenced by that page and listed in publish.ini. The maintained draw.io sources decode to the same labels used in the diagrams. Community searches found no later contradiction. Separate Task-resource state-machine language using 'claim' was traced to FHIR-14781 and left unchanged because it is outside this workflow-page issue.
reconciliation: Changed source/workflow-management.html to say fulfillers may 'pick' an open Task, and updated images/source/workflow-optionf.draw.io.xml, images/source/workflow-optionh.draw.io.xml, images/workflow-optionf.png, and images/workflow-optionh.png from 'PUT Claim Task' to 'PUT Pick Task'.
source_changes: source/workflow-management.html: replaced the open Task 'claim' wording with 'pick'.
